description:
Job details mentioned below 
 Title: Cobol Developer   
 Duration: 12+ Months 
 Location: Raleigh, NC  
 

 

 Required Skills: 
 

 • Knowledge and experience with COBOL 10years, CICS 10 yrs, VSAM 10yrs, and JCL 10yrs.
 • Knowledge and experience with Java, VB, SQL, and .Net
 • Knowledge and experience in modifying mainframe applications beginning with a user request through coding, testing and implementation 10 yrs.
 • Excellent interpersonal communication skills.
 • Organized software program documentation writing and process flow development skills
 

 Desired skills: 
 

 

 • Strong organizational skills.
 • Excellent analytical and problem solving skills.
 • Knowledge of Fault Analyzer
 • Knowledge and experience with IMS
 • Understand impact of interface and systems design decisions on technology, information flow, and/or business processes.
 

 Responsibilities include: 
 

 

 • Maintain and enhance mainframe programs and new interfaces for SCUBI by coding, testing and implementing interface programs.
 • Analyze existing programs and document their functionality
 • Corrects bugs in existing programs
 • Analyze data sent/received from other agencies and document the functionality needed to create the data and to process the data.
 • Develop interface specifications for the SCUBI CAPGEMINI team.
